audit.feedback: text_not_approved: Card 0 and the package title state Kane was released by Arsenal 'وعمره 8 سنين' (at age 8), but the cited passage only supports that he joined Arsenal's academy at age eight and was released 'after one season' — meaning the release itself happened around age 9, not 8. This is an unsupported precision/factual mismatch between the source and the card's claim, so facts_supported fails for card 0 (and the title). Aside from this, the shareable takeaway is solid and retellable: Kane was cut by Arsenal as a 'chubby' kid before becoming a €110m Bayern signing, and his missed penalty vs Spain (double-touch) would have been disallowed anyway under Law 14 even if scored. The story shows a documented beginning (Ridgeway Rovers 1999, Arsenal release), change (Tottenham debut penalty miss, rise through career), and outcome (Bayern move, current penalty controversy), with Info and story cards each adding distinct value.

editorial_review_rejected: The package's top-level headline still says «أرسنال استغنى عن هاري كين وعمره 8 سنين لأنه ممتلئ شوي», asserting he was RELEASED at age 8. The only supported fact (wiki-30483842) is that he JOINED Arsenal's academy at eight and was released 'after one season' — meaning the release itself happened closer to age nine, not eight. Card 0's own body correctly separates these two facts ('انضم... وعمره 8 سنين.. وطلعوه بعد موسم واحد'), but the headline reintroduces the exact unsupported precision that was already flagged and supposedly fixed in a prior repair round, so feedback_respected also fails. Separately, all three story images misrepresent their cards' subjects: Card index 1 (Tottenham debut vs Hearts, a CLUB match) uses a photo of Kane in ENGLAND NATIONAL TEAM kit alongside French midfielder Morgan Schneiderlin — an unrelated international fixture, not Tottenham colors or opponent. Card index 2 (Bayern Munich transfer/36 league goals) again shows Kane in England kit, not Bayern Munich colors, misrepresenting the club being discussed. Card index 3, explicitly about TODAY's England-vs-Spain penalty miss, uses an older photo showing Laurent Koscielny of FRANCE marking Kane — a different opponent from a different (historical) match, which misleadingly reads as depicting the current Spain fixture. This violates the rule requiring contemporary, opponent-matching imagery for a card framed as a current event, and more broadly the rule against using an unrelated team/kit to illustrate the entity's activity. An ordinary viewer's retellable takeaway (8-year-old 'chubby' Kane cut by Arsenal, doubted again on his empty Tottenham debut, later a €110m Bayern star, and today nearly benefited from a quirky VAR rule against Spain) is a genuinely strong, shareable arc, but the specific age claim in the title and the three mismatched match photos must be corrected before publication. Repair: (1) rewrite the top-level title/headline to not assert a specific release age (e.g., reference 'ب

text_not_approved: Card 2's closing punch ('ومع كل هذا الرصيد، وقف قدام الكرة أمام إسبانيا') raises the Spain penalty/double-touch event as a payoff but no card explains what happened (the missed penalty, the double-touch, law 14) — it's the last card, so the tease is never delivered, leaving an unresolved thread. The rest of the package (info: Arsenal release at 8 for being 'a bit chubby', Ridgeway Rovers at 6; card1: Tottenham debut penalty won and missed by Kane himself; card2 body: €110m Bayern move, 36 league goals) is factually supported by c4/c5/c6/c8 and gives a retellable arc (rejected as a kid → breakthrough at Tottenham → Bayern superstar), but the final punch's unresolved reference to the current event breaks story coherence. Fix: either drop the Spain reference from card2's punch or add the missing detail (double-touch, law 14, 5th miss in 31 attempts) so the punch pays off within the card itself.
